integrity: Full graph, complexes, orbit representatives, individual free-coface tests and dihedral homology traces are independently recomputed by the embedded standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite SG(3,2) case; no all-Schrijver-parameter claim; the sphere homotopy type was known. Absolute priority against unindexed work is not established. Equivariant assertion is an explicit orbitwise collapse, not a classification of sphere actions.
title: A dihedral-equivariant collapse from Schrijver independence to neighborhood topology
